title: Case VII (Serial 2728.00): Rotating Disc Drawing, Korea Air Force Base, June 6, 1952
description: Line drawing of the object in two views: a circle with concentric dashed rings and an arrow labeled "Rotation", captioned "Black lines evenly spaced", and a tall rectangle captioned "Proportion 7 to 1". A note reads "(Dimensions are as shown in observer's original drawing)". The text describes a Flight Sergeant's sighting of a spinning, tumbling object over an Air Force base in Korea at 0842 hours, which also maneuvered near the sun (page 83).
